name: Yellow Gold Oval Halo Ring
shortDescription: Simplicity that captivates. A yellow gold ring for elegant and timeless appearances.
description: Simplicity that captivates. This stunning oval halo ring features a brilliant center stone surrounded by a delicate halo of sparkling diamonds, all set in warm yellow gold. The pavé-set diamond band adds extra brilliance, making this piece perfect for engagements or special occasions. A timeless design that radiates elegance.

name: Gold Beaded Eternity Ring
shortDescription: A modern eternity ring available in 18K and 9K gold.
description: A beautifully crafted beaded eternity ring featuring a continuous row of polished gold beads that wrap around the finger. This minimalist yet striking design offers a contemporary take on the classic eternity band. Available in both 18K and 9K gold, this versatile piece can be worn alone or stacked with other rings for a personalized look.

name: White Gold Halo Stud Earrings
shortDescription: Handmade earrings ideal for every age and occasion.
description: Exquisite handmade halo stud earrings featuring radiant-cut center stones surrounded by brilliant diamond halos, all set in lustrous white gold. These versatile earrings are designed to be easy to wear and suitable for any occasion, from everyday elegance to special celebrations. A must-have accessory that will elevate every look. Stand out because you deserve it.

name: Diamond Milgrain Eternity Band
shortDescription: A delicate eternity ring with diamonds in 18K and 9K gold.
description: A stunning eternity band featuring alternating marquise and round diamond settings with intricate milgrain detailing. This delicate ring showcases exceptional craftsmanship with its vintage-inspired design. Available in both white and yellow gold, in 18K and 9K options, with your choice of zircons or natural diamonds. Perfect for stacking or wearing as a wedding band.

name: Handcrafted White Gold Cross
shortDescription: A unique handmade white gold cross pendant, designed and crafted in Cyprus.
description: A truly unique piece – this handmade white gold cross pendant is our own design and production, and has become one of our most beloved bestsellers. Crafted with care and attention to detail, this elegant cross accompanies you through life's most beautiful moments. Worn on a delicate chain, it makes a meaningful gift for christenings, confirmations, or any special occasion. Always worthy – may your little prince live long and prosper.

name: Gold Filigree Drop Earrings
shortDescription: Elegant filigree drop earrings with ruby center stones.
description: Exquisite yellow gold drop earrings featuring intricate filigree work in a beautiful floral design. Each earring is adorned with a vivid ruby-red center stone that adds a striking pop of color. The delicate openwork pattern showcases traditional goldsmithing techniques, creating a piece that is both timeless and eye-catching. Secured with lever-back clasps for comfortable all-day wear.

name: Gold Crucifix Cross Pendant
shortDescription: A unique handmade gold crucifix, designed and crafted in Cyprus.
description: A truly unique piece – this handmade gold crucifix pendant is of our own production and design, and has become one of our most beloved pieces with the highest sales. We thank you so much for being with us and choosing jewellery that accompanies you through life's most beautiful moments. This meaningful crucifix makes a perfect gift for christenings, confirmations, or any special religious occasion. Always worthy – may your little prince live long and prosper.

name: 18K Diamond Tennis Bracelet
shortDescription: Classic tennis bracelet in 18K white gold with brilliant diamonds.
description: The ultimate symbol of timeless elegance – this stunning 18K white gold tennis bracelet features a continuous line of brilliant round diamonds, each hand-set in a classic four-prong setting. The flexible design wraps beautifully around the wrist, creating an uninterrupted flow of sparkle. Secured with a secure clasp and safety lock, this bracelet is a luxurious investment piece that will be treasured for generations.

name: Diamond Tennis Necklace
shortDescription: An elegant diamond tennis necklace for effortless sophistication.
description: Pure elegance redefined – this diamond tennis necklace features a delicate strand of brilliant diamonds set in a continuous line around the neck. The timeless design sits beautifully at the collarbone, creating a stunning display of sparkle that catches the light with every movement. Whether worn alone for understated luxury or layered with other pieces, this necklace is the epitome of refined sophistication.

name: Virgin Mary Gold Pendant
shortDescription: New Virgin Mary pendant available in 18K and 9K gold.
description: A beautiful new addition to our religious collection – this exquisite Virgin Mary pendant features a delicate profile of the Madonna set within a circular frame adorned with sparkling zircons. Crafted in warm yellow gold and available in both 18K and 9K options, this meaningful piece makes a perfect gift for christenings, first communions, or any special occasion. Worn on a matching gold chain, it sits elegantly at the neckline.

name: Two-Tone Ladies Watch
shortDescription: Elegant two-tone ladies watch with blue dial and faceted bracelet.
description: A sophisticated ladies watch that combines elegance with modern design. The striking blue dial features gold-tone hands and indices, while the faceted two-tone stainless steel and gold bracelet catches the light beautifully. With day-date function and a comfortable fit, this timepiece is perfect for the woman who appreciates both style and functionality.

name: Crystal Bracelet Watch
shortDescription: Stunning quartz watch with crystal-encrusted bracelet and mother of pearl dial.
description: Pure glamour on your wrist – this dazzling ladies watch features a mother of pearl dial with elegant Roman numeral indices, surrounded by a bezel of sparkling crystals. The fully crystal-encrusted bracelet makes a bold statement, while the quartz movement ensures reliable timekeeping. Perfect for special occasions or adding sparkle to everyday looks.

name: Blue Sapphire Halo Ring
shortDescription: Handmade white gold ring with blue sapphire and zircon halo.
description: A stunning handmade ring in 18K or 9K white gold, featuring a magnificent oval blue sapphire as its centerpiece. The deep blue stone is surrounded by a sparkling halo of zircons and set on a pavé-set band for extra brilliance. A timeless piece with exceptional craftsmanship quality that will surely impress. Available in both white and yellow gold options.
